content.comment_body: Hello, I would like to know if it's possible to connect a screen using an analog logic cable, working only within the [product_name] software. Please reply if you know the answer. Thank you.

Which screen are you referring to? Do you mean an external screen or the one integrated into the system? Are you trying to read or write analog values? Please refer to the attached animation for further assistance.
Sorry, I think I can remove this question since I figured out the solution. Thank you—after seeing your reply, it helped me even more.
Hello. To benefit the community, it would be great if you could share your solution. The purpose of the forum is to support each other and provide future users with valuable information.
Yes, sorry! The solution was that I didn't notice the block called "texte de message" in French, which is likely "message texte" in English.

analysis.insight_summary: User inquired about the possibility of connecting a display to an analog function within [product_name] software, focusing specifically on the software aspect. There was initial confusion around which screen and the type of analog interaction, but the user later resolved the issue by identifying a particular feature block in the software. The key challenge was recognizing the feature and navigating language differences, highlighting the importance of feature discoverability and localization in software interfaces.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects straightforward and accessible tools or documentation in the software to enable displaying analog information on a screen. There is also an expectation for easier identification of important features or blocks, regardless of language settings.
